pair_note: Predecessor active_work_sec was zero, so this boundary is retained as an idle-gap observation but excluded from useful-work utilization/cutoff inference.

decision.reason: Recent short-run pairs establish that voluntary handoff in the tens-of-seconds region is costly, but they do not test the intended near-frontier same-wake duration. Scheduler mechanism remains unchanged. Future frontier claims require actually completed useful work and observed work_end_time; projected duration is invalid evidence.

measurement_guard.rule: work_end_time must be an observed completed-work timestamp at or before the state write; active_work_sec must represent completed useful work only
measurement_guard.purpose: prevent projected durations from being misclassified as runtime-frontier evidence
